profile.headline: Software Engineer at J.P. Morgan Healthcare Payments

positions.title: Senior Mortgage Application Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Assisted integrations team through analysis of API, XML, and MISMO code and collaborate with vendors to address client issues and ensure data accuracy.
• Assisted QA team by thoroughly testing each field and page of Loan Origination System (LOS) and reporting inconsistent / incorrect behavior.
• Served as pioneer for the rollout of brand new system by creating and document team processes as well as complex system behavior.

positions.title: Senior Software Support Analyst
positions.description:
•	Troubleshot client issues ranging from technical questions regarding loan origination system (LOS) software system behavior to compliance questions about the mortgage industry.
•	Reduced strain on engineering team’s resources by analyzing LOS C# codebase for complex mortgage calculation questions, allowing developers to continue to create new features and address bugs.
•	Increased efficiency of support teams by documenting over 100 articles per year on Atlassian Confluence on system processes and mortgage/compliance concepts.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Fundraised over $400 within three months to grant an underprivileged child the opportunity to personally grow beyond the limitations of his/her economic conditions.
•	Fostered the leadership and interpersonal skills of seven campers by developing and implementing programs which required communication and teamwork, tending to the children over the course of a week at Camp River Glen.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Vietnamese Student Union's High School Conference
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Promoted higher education by informing local high school students about the opportunity to attend an event hosted by UCLA designed to empower attendees with knowledge of the admissions process and life in college.
•	Managed over 100 students, phone-banking applicants before the event to confirm acceptance and organizing registration on the day of to make sure every attendee was properly sorted into their respective groups.

company.name: Vietnamese Student Union's High School Conference

projects.title: TripReady - Travel Mobile Application
projects.description:
•	Utilized the Flutter framework, Google Firebase, and Github to implement an iOS/Android-compatible app. as part of senior Capstone project; app. was developed through a collaborative effort between three team members.
•	Prominent features of the app. include creating trips based on date/location, popular sites/restaurants, a virtual wallet, an item checklist, a tips checklist, and crowdsourcing functionality for each checklist.
•	Specific responsibilities included coming up with the idea for the app., drafting up mockups, and developing two of four of the application’s main features: the virtual wallet and tips checklist.

projects.title: UCLA Environmental Science Practicum
projects.description:
•	Bolstered the success of The Growing Experience urban farm through gathering and documenting six months of environmental and social impact data, allowing representatives to apply for additional grants.
•	Improved the lives of the Carmelitos Housing Project’s residents through conducting surveys that: advocated a healthy diet, created awareness of the local urban farm, and noted suggestions to accommodate the less fortunate. 
•	Spearheaded the synthesis the 55-page report, formatting the table of contents, figures, and tables; proofreading each group member’s section; and utilizing Endnote to compile every scientific paper referenced.
